t: The only thing between people and seeing their Lord
a: وَمَا بَيْنَ الْقَوْمِ وَبَيْنَ أَنْ يَنْظُرُوا إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى إِلاَّ رِدَاءُ الْكِبْرِيَاءِ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ فِي جَنَّةِ عَدْنٍ
p: Wa mā bayna-l-qawmi wa bayna an yanẓurū ilā rabbihim illā ridāʾu-l-kibriyāʾi ʿalā wajhihi fī jannati ʿAdn
m: And there is nothing between the people and seeing their Lord except the cloak of majesty over His face, in the Garden of Eden.
